ops.text: Orchestrator landing pipeline raced live lane agents THREE times in the v14 P2 phase (p0-bench: landed while the agent was still refining; render: landed a commit while a fix directive was outstanding, agent amended a diverged replacement; smallmods: rebased+amended+removed the worktree while the agent was mid-consolidation-edit — its git amend corrupted against my concurrent jj export, though the content survived by being swept into my `git add -A` amend and gated green). Root cause each time: the orchestrator operating IN a lane's worktree (rebase/fmt/amend/remove) while the lane agent was not confirmed stopped. Remedy for future multi-lane orchestration: before landing a lane, either (a) get an explicit final "lane closed, no edits in flight" ack AND send no further directives, or (b) never touch the lane's worktree — cherry-pick/fetch its commits into an orchestrator-owned scratch worktree (the parse-dedup early landing did this correctly) and let the agent's copy die untouched. `git add -A` during landing amends is especially dangerous — it sweeps whatever a concurrent editor left on disk (worked out by luck this time: the swept edit was complete and the gate was strict).
